iris.design: Quick follow-up from the usability lab: when a run has multiple tool calls the validation panels create a lot of visual noise. Users couldn't tell which tool produced the mismatch at a glance.

ben.devex: Good point. Current approach stacks full validation below every call. For dense runs that means heavy scrolling.

sam.prod: Can we try a compact inline badge next to the tool header: [OrderV2] [!Mismatch] that opens a small popover with 1-2 example diffs? Less vertical space, easier scan.

noah.a11y: Accessibility: the badge must be focusable and have an accessible name like "Schema validation, OrderV2, mismatch". Popover should be a dialog role with focus trap and an aria-describedby pointing to the short diff summary.

kai.runtime: Backend can help: add a light `validation_summary` to invocation payloads, e.g. a short string and an examples array. Clients render the short string in the badge and fetch full diffs on demand. Also include `schema_fingerprint` to dedupe schemas.

ben.devex: UX sketch: badge = icon + short text (max 18 chars). Enter/Space opens popover; Esc closes. Popover shows truncated expected vs actual monospace diff and a link "Open full inspector" that anchors the right-side inspector.

iris.design: Copy options for badge: "OK", "Mismatch", "Partial match". Prefer nouns for consistency. Tooltip: "Schema validation: Mismatch. Press Enter to inspect."

sam.prod: Product wants a run-history filter: "only runs with validation issues" and a sort option to surface them. Should be backend-filterable like ?validation=has_issues.

noah.a11y: Notes: don't rely on color only. Include textual status in the badge and announce new validation issues with aria-live="polite" when a run completes. Also avoid the label "raw" for JSON view; use "Open JSON view".

ci-bot: CI: visual diff job queued for playground-run-list + run-detail. Test id: 20260323-17.

ben.devex: Next steps: kai to add minimal `validation_summary` + `schema_fingerprint` to API, iris to mock badge/popover variants and hand off to noah for a11y review, sam to prioritize run-history filter. I'll open a small PR for badge rendering once API shape is stable.

iris.design: I'll drop Figma mock links here when ready. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
